risks.title: Increased regulation of the BNPL sector
risks.score_rationale: The risk is positioned at the top of the 'Risks Related to Our Industry' section, with strong language ('materially and adversely affect'). Growing regulatory scrutiny in the U.S. and elsewhere, combined with the 2025 change in administration, increases the likelihood of major impact. The Regulation category is highly weighted in financial services.

risks.title: Intensifying competition in digital payments
risks.score_rationale: The text describes competition as 'intense' and 'dynamic' with larger, better-funded players. Multiple paragraphs are dedicated to this risk, indicating its priority. The risk is amplified by the potential entry of major financial institutions and technology giants.

risks.title: Dependence on macroeconomic conditions
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well-developed, with direct effects on loan repayments and consumer spending. The tone is concerned but less alarming than on regulation. It is recurring in prior reports, indicating a stable trend.

risks.title: Difficulty maintaining profitability
risks.score_rationale: The company incurred significant losses before 2023. Although now profitable, it anticipates heavy investments. The text explicitly highlights the risk of returning to losses if revenues do not keep pace. The Capital category is strongly impacted.

risks.title: Loss of consumers or low customer retention
risks.score_rationale: The risk is repeated multiple times, particularly regarding costly acquisition and retention. It is directly tied to revenues (GMV). The text mentions a risk of 'high turnover', increasing costs. Central positioning in the 10-K.

risks.title: Dependence on subscription revenues
risks.score_rationale: 22% of revenues come from subscriptions in 2025, described as 'key' to the future. The text emphasizes risks related to retention, perceived value, and competition. A decline in subscriptions would have a direct impact on financial health.

risks.title: Reputational damage risk
risks.score_rationale: The risk is well-developed, with an exhaustive list of potential causes of negative publicity. The text explicitly links reputation to platform usage. While less existential than regulation, it can amplify other risks.

risks.title: Loss of key merchants
risks.score_rationale: The text underscores the importance of major merchants for platform attractiveness. Pricing pressure and competition are strong. Direct risk to GMV and growth, although partially covered by other risks.

ai_positioning.summary: Company SEZL does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
